product_metadata.title: SIKITUT Water Bottle Storage Rack, 3 Bottle Organizer for Water, Wine, and Drink, Cup Organizer for Kitchen Cabinets, Countertop, Pantry, Fridge, Free-Standing Stackable, Clear, 2 Pack
features: STACKABLE DESIGN: 2 pack holders can be stacked up horizontally, each rack holds up to 3 water bottles. The bottle organizer can be used separated or stacked, perfect for pantry organization and storage or kitchen organization.

STURDY AND DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: The bottle storage organizers are made of durable and clear high quality PET plastic. The anti-slip pattern on the bottom ensures that the bottle can be placed on the rack stably, the firm base ensures that the rack can be placed on the table stably.

PERFECT STORAGE SIZE: Each shelf measures 8” x 11.9” x 4.5”, perfectly compatible with water bottles, drink bottles, stainless steel water bottles, glass water bottles, bottled beverages, sports drinks, fitness drinks, and many more.

IDEAL STORAGE ORGANIZATION: These bottle organizers can create vertical storage to save your space. Ideal storage solution for keeping your pantry, kitchen cabinet, cupboard, refrigerator, counters, tables, clean and neatly organized.

FUNCTIONAL AND VERSATILE: With the temperature range: -4°F-140°F, this multi-use storage bin is also great for storing wine bottles, soda, and chilled drinks. This item is also a perfect wine rack stand and a refrigerator bin.

details.Product Care Instructions: Wipe with Dry Cloth, Hand Wash
